name: How can I minimize tenant displacement during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I minimize tenant displacement during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minimizing tenant displacement during a remodel often involves careful planning and communication. For occupied units, consider performing renovations during off-peak hours, tackling one room at a time, or scheduling work during a tenant's vacation. For vacant units, aim to complete renovations quickly between tenants. Discuss potential inconveniences with tenants in advance and offer temporary solutions if possible, such as access to alternative facilities if a bathroom or kitchen is unusable. Expediting material delivery and having a detailed work schedule are also key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minimize displacement by planning carefully, scheduling work efficiently, and communicating openly with tenants, potentially renovating during vacancies or in phases.
